cache_policy: same lazy observed-prefix cache and AALpy membership cache for all eight methods; new paths replay and charge all prefix actions
integration_track: same streaming AALpy L* with RS refinement; no shrinking or regression-query phase for any method; M3 complete-loop integration tested separately
support_rule: at least five seeds, three families, no failed cells; per family >=80% paired AULC wins and positive median against BOTH native baselines; all families SUPPORTED, some PARTIALLY SUPPORTED, none NOT SUPPORTED; insufficient or failed INCONCLUSIVE
auc_rule: left-constant step integral from (0,0), normalized by maximum ceiling
threshold_rule: first fixed checkpoint with >=95% exact traces; unreached remains null
budget_rule: equal physical-action ceilings; exact spending and early policy stops reported, no padding
